1022b15: Affection is said in one sense to be a quality in virtue of which alteration is
1022b16: possible, e.g. white and black, and
1022b19: already. Further, even more than these, the harmful alterations and changes,
1022b20: and most of all the painful harms. Further, the magnitudes of
1022b21: misfortunes and of painful sufferings are called affections.
